rows.vgi.doc_md:
## Curated Feed Registry

A browsable, zero-argument view listing well-known public **RSS / Atom / JSON** feeds — a starting point for discovery when you do not already have a feed URL in hand.

### Columns

- **`name`** — human-friendly feed name.
- **`url`** — the feed URL to hand to `feed_items(input)` or `feed_info(input)`.
- **`feed_type`** — the feed format (`rss`, `atom`, or `json`).
- **`category`** — a broad topic (Technology, News, Science, Security, Comics).
- **`description`** — a one-line summary of the feed.

### Notes

The registry is a static list, so it returns instantly with no network access. Pick a `url` here, then parse it with the feed table functions.

rows: CREATE VIEW feed_registry AS SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('Hacker News Front Page', 'https://hnrss.org/frontpage', 'rss', 'Technology', 'Front-page stories from Hacker News.'), ('NASA Breaking News', 'https://www.nasa.gov/feed/', 'rss', 'Science', 'Breaking news and mission updates from NASA.'), ('BBC News World', 'https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/world/rss.xml', 'rss', 'News', 'Top world news headlines from the BBC.'), ('The Verge', 'https://www.theverge.com/rss/index.xml', 'atom', 'Technology', 'Technology, science, and culture reporting from The Verge.'), ('GitHub Blog', 'https://github.blog/feed/', 'rss', 'Technology', 'Product, engineering, and community posts from GitHub.'), ('Daring Fireball', 'https://daringfireball.net/feeds/main', 'atom', 'Technology', 'John Gruber''s commentary on Apple and technology.'), ('xkcd', 'https://xkcd.com/rss.xml', 'rss', 'Comics', 'The xkcd webcomic of romance, sarcasm, math, and language.'), ('Krebs on Security', 'https://krebsonsecurity.com/feed/', 'rss', 'Security', 'In-depth security news and investigation from Brian Krebs.'), ('JSON Feed', 'https://www.jsonfeed.org/feed.json', 'json', 'Technology', 'The reference JSON Feed published by the format''s authors.'), ('Query Farm', 'https://query.farm/index.xml', 'atom', 'Technology', 'Posts and release notes from Query Farm.')) AS valueslist) AS t("name", url, feed_type, category, description);
